text.en: The river says, with more people and factories near my banks, waste, plastic and dirty water pollute me. Sometimes I do not smell or look clean.

With more people and factories near the banks, waste, plastic and dirty water pollute the river. Yet people use its water, which could make them sick.
Fish, turtles and birds that live in and around the river have nowhere else to go, and slowly they begin to disappear.
One important way to help is to create less waste in the first place, using eco-friendly products.
Where do the plastic wrappers we litter end up? Often in drains and then rivers. Where does the unclean water mixed with cleaners go?
Ask your parents or elders about the condition of water bodies near your home when they were children. Compare it with today.
List the things you throw in the waste bin at home or school. If these things were thrown into a river, what would happen?
When you open a tap, remember the journey the water has taken and the many sacrifices made. Use water wisely and never waste it.

problem.en: Name two ways to protect a river.

text.en: Do not throw waste or plastic into it.
Use eco-friendly soaps and make less waste.

prompt.en: Why should we keep rivers clean?

requiredIdeas.en: Many living things depend on them
Dirty water can make people sick
Less waste means a cleaner river

points.en: Make less waste and use water wisely.
